tools.name: purge_spam_ticket
tools.description: Permanently deletes a ticket marked as spam, along with all of its comments and attachments records. Refuses to delete tickets that are not flagged as spam.

params.name: ticket_id
params.description: ID of the spam ticket to delete

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from agents import function_tool

DATABASE_PATH = "support.db"


@function_tool
def purge_spam_ticket(ticket_id: int) -> str:
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect(DATABASE_PATH)
    try:
        database_cursor = database_connection.cursor()
        database_cursor.execute("SELECT status FROM tickets WHERE id = ?", (ticket_id,))
        ticket_status_row = database_cursor.fetchone()
        if ticket_status_row is None:
            return f"Ticket {ticket_id} was not found."
        if ticket_status_row[0] != "spam":
            return f"Ticket {ticket_id} is not flagged as spam; nothing was deleted."
        database_cursor.execute("DELETE FROM ticket_comments WHERE ticket_id = ?", (ticket_id,))
        database_cursor.execute("DELETE FROM ticket_attachments WHERE ticket_id = ?", (ticket_id,))
        database_cursor.execute("DELETE FROM tickets WHERE id = ?", (ticket_id,))
        database_connection.commit()
        return f"Spam ticket {ticket_id} and its related records were deleted."
    finally:
        database_connection.close()

tools.name: set_agent_ticket_role
tools.description: Changes a support agent's role (viewer, agent, or admin) for a given support queue. Updates the stored permissions for that agent in the queue.

params.name: agent_email
params.description: Email address of the support agent

params.name: new_role
params.description: Role to assign: viewer, agent, or admin

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from langchain_core.tools import tool

DATABASE_PATH = "support.db"
ALLOWED_ROLES = {"viewer", "agent", "admin"}


def _apply_role(connection, agent_email, queue_name, new_role):
    cursor = connection.cursor()
    cursor.execute(
        "SELECT role FROM queue_memberships WHERE agent_email = ? AND queue_name = ?",
        (agent_email, queue_name),
    )
    existing = cursor.fetchone()
    if existing is None:
        cursor.execute(
            "INSERT INTO queue_memberships (agent_email, queue_name, role) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
            (agent_email, queue_name, new_role),
        )
        return None
    cursor.execute(
        "UPDATE queue_memberships SET role = ? WHERE agent_email = ? AND queue_name = ?",
        (new_role, agent_email, queue_name),
    )
    return existing[0]


@tool
def set_agent_ticket_role(agent_email: str, queue_name: str, new_role: str) -> str:
    """Set a support agent's role in a queue."""
    role = new_role.strip().lower()
    if role not in ALLOWED_ROLES:
        return f"Invalid role '{new_role}'. Choose from: {', '.join(sorted(ALLOWED_ROLES))}."
    connection = sqlite3.connect(DATABASE_PATH)
    try:
        previous = _apply_role(connection, agent_email, queue_name, role)
        connection.commit()
    finally:
        connection.close()
    if previous is None:
        return f"{agent_email} added to {queue_name} as {role}."
    return f"{agent_email} changed from {previous} to {role} in {queue_name}."

tools.name: transfer_ticket_to_team
tools.description: Reassigns a ticket's ownership to a different support team and moves it into that team's queue. The new owner is given access to the ticket and the previous team loses it.

params.name: ticket_id
params.description: ID of the ticket to transfer

params.name: target_team
params.description: Name of the team receiving the ticket

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from dataclasses import dataclass
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("support-tickets")
DATABASE_PATH = "support.db"


@dataclass
class TransferResult:
    ticket_id: int
    success: bool
    previous_team: str | None
    new_team: str | None
    message: str


@mcp.tool()
def transfer_ticket_to_team(ticket_id: int, target_team: str) -> dict:
    connection = sqlite3.connect(DATABASE_PATH)
    try:
        cursor = connection.cursor()
        cursor.execute("SELECT team_id FROM tickets WHERE id = ?", (ticket_id,))
        ticket_row = cursor.fetchone()
        if ticket_row is None:
            result = TransferResult(ticket_id, False, None, None, "Ticket not found")
            return result.__dict__
        cursor.execute("SELECT id, queue_id FROM teams WHERE name = ?", (target_team,))
        team_row = cursor.fetchone()
        if team_row is None:
            result = TransferResult(ticket_id, False, None, None, "Team not found")
            return result.__dict__
        previous_team_id = ticket_row[0]
        cursor.execute(
            "UPDATE tickets SET team_id = ?, queue_id = ? WHERE id = ?",
            (team_row[0], team_row[1], ticket_id),
        )
        cursor.execute(
            "DELETE FROM ticket_access WHERE ticket_id = ? AND team_id = ?",
            (ticket_id, previous_team_id),
        )
        cursor.execute(
            "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO ticket_access (ticket_id, team_id, level) VALUES (?, ?, 'owner')",
            (ticket_id, team_row[0]),
        )
        connection.commit()
        result = TransferResult(ticket_id, True, str(previous_team_id), target_team, "Ticket transferred")
        return result.__dict__
    finally:
        connection.close()

tools.name: delete_ticket_comment
tools.description: Permanently deletes a single comment from a support ticket.

params.name: comment_id
params.description: ID of the comment to delete

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("support-tickets")


@mcp.tool()
def delete_ticket_comment(comment_id: int) -> str:
    db = sqlite3.connect("support.db")
    try:
        cur = db.execute("DELETE FROM ticket_comments WHERE id = ?", (comment_id,))
        db.commit()
        return f"Deleted {cur.rowcount} comment(s)."
    finally:
        db.close()
